summary: No installer-harm signals observed in simple-date-formatter-util@1.0.0
details: The package appears to be a small date-formatting utility. No credential access, no install-time or import-time network activity, no lifecycle scripts fetching remote content, no obfuscated payloads, and no destinations consistent with exfiltration or command-and-control were observed. Nothing in the shipped contents matches known supply-chain attack fingerprints (installer-secret reads, dropper patterns, silent-relay of caller data, dependency-chain lure).
